machine_note: single workstation (16 logical CPUs, 32 GB RAM); at most 8 worker processes; one historical tape in memory at a time

budgets.medium: registered confirmatory size unless a design states otherwise
budgets.large: only if a sealed design requests it

early_stopping: none: every planned unit runs; interrupted runs resume from checkpoints with identical settings or are retained as ABORTED attempts
planning_rule: a plan.json (planner estimate + seed plan from a dev-seed pilot SD) is written before every confirmatory run
